newsitem.title: ITALY: Saes Getters 1997 H1 profit, turnover up.
newsitem.headline: Saes Getters 1997 H1 profit, turnover up.

text.p: Italian electronic components maker Saes Getters said it posted first half 1997 consolidated net profit of 14.1 billion lire, 55.9 percent up on the same 1996 period.
The group, which is also listed on Nasdaq, said in a statement that first half turnover totalled 101.7 billion lire, a rise of 14.5 percent.
It also said that second quarter consolidated net profit was 8.6 billion lire against 3.0 billion in the second quarter of 1996 on turnover of 54.8 billion lire against 46.3 billion.
